cases.instruction: An h11 application sits behind a reverse proxy. Audit the HTTP/1.1 chunked-body reader for framing that h11 accepts but that a different chunked parser may delimit differently, which is the precondition for request smuggling. Report the exact sink line. Use two parsing ends to show the disagreement; accepting a malformed body by itself is not proof of smuggling, so describe the cross-parser difference rather than claiming a completed exploit.
